Overview & City Profile

Jangseong-eup (장성읍) is a municipality in Jangseong-gun, South Jeolla (coordinates 35.3224°N, 126.8277°E; population 42,129). Visitors use Jangseong-eup as a base to explore South Jeolla's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Yeosu Gejang (marinated crab), Boseong green tea dishes, Suncheon cockle bibimbap (Kkomak).

Within South Jeolla Region (Jangseong-gun region), Jangseong-eup (장성읍) serves as a administrative city / district in south jeolla region. Travelers exploring South Jeolla often combine a stop in Jangseong-eup with regional highlights such as Suncheonman Bay National Garden & Wetlands, Yeosu Night Sea & Odongdo, Boseong Green Tea Fields, Damyang Juknokwon Bamboo Forest.

Getting to Jangseong-eup & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Muan Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)): KTX to Yeosu Expo, Suncheon and Mokpo stations.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in South Jeolla Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Muan with Jangseong-eup. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep ₩1,000 bills and ₩100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in South Jeolla have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Jangseong-eup en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Jangseong-eup are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail station or airport in South Jeolla can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in South Korea Guide.

What to Eat in Jangseong-eup & South Jeolla

Jangseong-eup shares the culinary traditions of South Jeolla Region and the wider Jangseong-gun region. Don't miss these local specialties during your visit:

  • Yeosu Gejang (marinated crab) — a signature specialty across South Jeolla Region.
  • Boseong green tea dishes — a signature specialty across South Jeolla Region.
  • Suncheon cockle bibimbap (Kkomak) — a signature specialty across South Jeolla Region.
  • Damyang tteokgalbi & bamboo rice — a signature specialty across South Jeolla Region.

For dietary restrictions or food allergies, open our South Korea Phrasebook & Show-to-Staff Cards to display clear South Korea dietary explanations at restaurants in Jangseong-eup.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit South Jeolla: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.

Regional highlights across South Jeolla Region that pair well with a visit to Jangseong-eup include: Suncheonman Bay National Garden & Wetlands, Yeosu Night Sea & Odongdo, Boseong Green Tea Fields, Damyang Juknokwon Bamboo Forest.

Practical Travel Tips for Jangseong-eup

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Jangseong-eup (or at Muan Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Jangseong-eup accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and South Korea Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Jangseong-eup (장성읍) located in South Korea?

Jangseong-eup (장성읍) is a administrative city / district located in South Jeolla Region in the Jangseong-gun region of South Korea (coordinates: 35.3224°N, 126.8277°E). It has a population of approximately 42,129 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Jangseong-eup by train?

Most visitors reach Jangseong-eup via the main prefectural gateway of Muan Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail). KTX to Yeosu Expo, Suncheon and Mokpo stations. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Jangseong-eup. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare Calculator.

What local food is Jangseong-eup and South Jeolla known for?

In Jangseong-eup and across South Jeolla Region, top local dishes include Yeosu Gejang (marinated crab), Boseong green tea dishes, Suncheon cockle bibimbap (Kkomak), as well as Damyang tteokgalbi & bamboo rice. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Jangseong-eup?

Best time to visit South Jeolla: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov. Check our South Korea Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
